correctness.rationale: For every irrational slope in the open interval the mechanical prefix-sum phase partition proves exactly n+1 factors and exactly one left-special factor per length; the characteristic phase proves it is each prefix. Bounds on 2,3,5-block symbol counts forbid 11,000,10101 and fix the length-five contexts. First-two-one gap parameters leave exactly two possible equal-image pairs; left-special uniqueness gives at most one each, and prefix contexts prove both exist. Their leading image-zero-run lengths distinguish them; small lengths are explicitly checked. Exact finite independent substitution and rational-interval stack programs corroborate, but do not replace the infinite proof.
